title: The Broken Bridges
intro_text: The streets crumble into bottomless voids. Place stolen blocks into the abyss to build walkable bridges, and reclaim them from behind.

levels.name: First Gap
levels.hint: The path terminates at a chasm. Place your carried fragment into the void to create a bridge, then walk across.

levels.name: Obstacle to Bridge
levels.hint: The fragment is an obstacle on floor, but a bridge over void. Siphon it to clear the hallway, then drop it into the abyss.

levels.name: Island Hop
levels.hint: A solitary pillar lies across the gap. Bridge the gap to reach the pillar, recover a second fragment, and pave your way to the exit.

levels.name: The Leapfrog
levels.hint: With only one block in the chamber, cross the first gap, turn around, siphon your bridge back from behind, and cast it forward.

levels.name: The Grand Divide
levels.hint: Multiple chasms divide the skyway. Coordinate bridge construction and recovery to traverse the abyss.
